verdict.rationale: Salv's own AI-Powered Insights adjudicates sanctions name-match alerts and explains its reasoning. That is a first-party AI capability that does some investigation and produces a rationale, but it is limited to name matching and is informational only. The evidence shows no agent that investigates transaction-monitoring alerts or drafts review notes into cases; case notes appear to be written manually. Missing for 10: an agent investigating transaction-monitoring alerts, AI-drafted review or case notes, agentic multi-step investigation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to investigate transaction alerts and prepare review notes

citations.quote: AI-Powered Insights adjudicates a name match and explains its reasoning, but it's informational only: it never closes an alert or makes the decision.
